entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. Just give me a yes or no, can I do it?
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. Look, I tried to do this ten days ago, on your Day 9, but your whole system was down.
I see. I do apologize for any trouble with the website. Can you tell me what happened when you tried to process the return?
It was a total website error. The page wouldn't load, and I couldn't print a return label. I have a screenshot of the error page if you need it.
Thank you for that information, I appreciate it. Let me just pull up your account. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered 19 days ago.
Right. So can I return it or not?

Yes. I see a note here confirming that the system was down for maintenance that day. And looking at our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that for you and email you a new label right now.
Of course. I've just sent it to the email on file. You should receive it within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
